additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-34261 had already changed Endpoint.connectionType to 1..*, matching the cardinality note in FHIR-36589. FHIR-38799 later made the mCSD link clickable, and FHIR-38798 removed stale IHE copyright text from the core endpoint connection type ValueSet. The old IID Endpoint example remains only in inactive/retired context: its Endpoint example list entry is commented out and its remaining source reference is from ImagingManifest, which is listed under removed resources.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current build-scope source has Endpoint.connectionType as 1..* CodeableConcept with an example binding, the Endpoint notes link to IHE mCSD, and active IHE XCA example content uses the IHE mCSD CodeSystem.
